 Nepal Premier League 2026: Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Karnali Yaks and Sudurpaschim Royals vs Chitwan Rhinos – match predictions, November 2

 By Cricket World Staff 
 Sunday 1 November 2026 
 Nepal Premier League

 Scorecard Stats

 The Nepal Premier League 2026 continues on November 2 with two exciting T20 encounters, as Kathmandu Gorkhas take on Karnali Yaks in Match 10, followed by Sudurpaschim Royals against Chitwan Rhinos in Match 11.
 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026, 10th Match - Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Karnali Yaks and 11th Match - Sudurpaschim Royals vs Chitwan Rhinos, to be played on the 2nd of November at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Batting Stats T20 
 10th Match - Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Karnali Yaks (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
Ground Stat:

Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137
 Current Form Kathmandu Gorkhas:
 Kathmandu Gorkhas are currently placed at the 7th position on points table with 1 win and 1 loss to their credit. They have 0 point to their name. 
The top run scorer for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Bhim Sharki with 33 runs to his name.
The top wicket taker for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Ripon Mondol with 1 scalp under his belt. 
Kathmandu Gorkhas have lost their previous match against Janakpur Bolts by 8 wickets.
Kathmandu Gorkhas batted first and they posted a total of 115 before being bowled out. The start was quite shaky and Kathmandu Gorkhas were reduced to 29 for 3 in the 6th over itself. Bhim Sharki then fought hard, scored 33 runs and tried his best to revive the innings for Kathmandu Gorkhas. However, wickets kept falling in regular succession around him and Kathmandu Gorkhas never looked in rhythm. Rahul Yadav picked up 4 wickets for 31 runs while Saif Hassan accounted for 2 scalps as Kathmandu Gorkhas were eventually bowled out for a paltry 115 on board
During the chase, Janakpur Bolts lost the key wickets of Trit Raj Das and Mayan Yadav quite early. After their dismissals, Moeen Ali and Saif Hassan took the responsibility of taking Janakpur Bolts over the line. They scored 58 and 40 runs respectively as Janakpur Bolts managed to chase the target down in the 18th over itself with 8 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Karnali Yaks:
 Karnali Yaks are currently placed at the 1st position on points table with 2 wins to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. 
The top run scorer for Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Ariful Islam with 75 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Sompal Kami with 5 scalps under his belt. 
Karnali Yaks have won their previous match against Biratnagar Kings by 4 wickets.
Biratnagar Kings batted first and they posted a big total of 186 for 7 in 20 overs. Imran Sheikh, Charith Asalanka and Shehan Jayasuriya all got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Lokesh Bam came into his own. He smashed the bowlers to all parts and made 87 runs off only 52 balls, collecting 3 fours and 9 sixes. Andre Russell also made a very valuable contribution of 27 runs in 15 balls towards the back end to propel Biratnagar Kings to a highly ompetitive total of 186 in 20 overs of play.
During the chase, Karnali Yaks lost their opener Mark Watt quite early. Ariful Islam played some good looking boundaries but he also threw it away after getting the start. Karnali Yaks were reduced to 57 for 5 in the 7th over itself and looked in all sorts of bother. After that phase, Sompal Kami and Gulshan Jha took it in their own hands to take Karnali Yaks home. Jha made 28 off 21 balls while Kami smashed 62 runs in only 32 deliveries. Both stayed not out and won the game for Biratnagar Kings in the last over with 4 wickets in hand.

 Current Form Sudurpaschim Royals:
 Sudurpaschim Royals are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 1 win and 2 losses to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. 
The top run scorer for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dipendra Singh Airee with 79 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Anil Kharel with 5 scalps under his belt. 
Sudurpaschim Royals have lost their previous match against Biratnagar Kings by 25 runs.
The match was reduced to 5 overs per side due to rain. 
Biratnagar Kings batted first and they posted a highly competitive total of 105 in 5 overs of play. Shehan Jayasuriya and Lokesh Bam started off very well for Biratnagar Kings. Jayasuriya made 39 off 11 balls, collecting 2 fours and 5 sixes. Lokesh Bam and Andre Russell were also quite destructive with the bat. Bam made 25 while Russell scored 29 runs in only 10 balls as Biratnagar Kings managed to get to 105 in 5 overs of play.
During the chase, Sudurpaschim Royals lost their way right from the word go. They lost the key wickets of Sherfane Rutherford and Dipendra Singh Airee quite early. After their dismissals, Saif Zaib and Aarif Sheikh tried to revive the innings but both of them got out at a wrong time. Sudurpaschim Royals couldn't really stage a comeback after that and they were eventually restricted to 70 for 3 in 5 overs, losing the match by a big margin of 35 runs.
 Current Form Chitwan Rhinos:
 /cricket/series/nepal-premier-league-2026/points/130224 
 Chitwan Rhinos are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 1 win and 1 No Result Match to their credit.
The top run scorer for Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dawid Malan with 70 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kamal Singh Airee with 4 scalps under his belt.
The previous match of Chitwan Rhinos against Lumbini Lions was cancelled due to rain. However, in their last outing, they won against Biratnagar Kings by 8 runs.
Chitwan Rhinos batted first and they posted a total of 157 for 3 in 20 overs. Dev Khanal and Dawid Malan started off very well for Chitwan Rhinos. Malan was the aggressor in the partnership. They collected 58 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Khanal made 12 while Malan went on to score 70 runs in only 50 balls, hitting 5 fours and 5 sixes. Ravi Bopara and Dan Mousley also contributed healthily, scoring 31 and 29 runs respectively to help Chitwan Rhinos get to 157 in 20 overs of play.
During the chase, Imran Sheikh and Lokesh Bam began very well. Sheikh made 39 runs while Bam scored 26 runs but both of them got out at a wrong time. After their dismissals, the middle order struggled a lot. Andre Russell smashed 33 off 17 balls but he also threw it away. The lower order failed to produce any impact and Biratnagar Kings were eventually bowled out for 149, losing the match by 8 runs.
